body.x: Mindhub Inc. (CEO Lee Haesung) announced its participation in CES 2025, from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, to present its AI-driven cognitive and language rehabilitation solution, "Zenicog," at the K-Startup Pavilion.

Mindhub is a digital healthcare company specializing in cognitive and language rehabilitation through AI. Its flagship product, Zenicog, has garnered attention across the industry. Approximately 150 institutions in Korea, including hospitals, welfare centers, and rehabilitation and developmental facilities, have adopted it.

Building on its established presence in the domestic market, Mindhub aims to leverage CES 2025 to introduce Zenicog further internationally and launch marketing and business initiatives targeting the global senior healthcare market.

Zenicog employs patented AI technology to dynamically optimize personalized training content for cognitive and language rehabilitation. The algorithm evaluates various parameters related to the trainee, adjusts task difficulty levels, and defines goals and stages to enable consistent, effective training.

Zenicog also supports remote monitoring for institutions, allowing users to receive hospital-level training at home. According to Mindhub, its cross-platform compatibility enhances accessibility and minimizes initial costs, offering exceptional economic efficiency in system operations.

Zenicog’s advanced data integration capabilities are another key feature. The system synthesizes and analyzes patient information from various sources, including healthcare professionals and caregivers, to generate content tailored to each patient’s cognitive and linguistic progress. The remote monitoring feature also enables healthcare providers to track rehabilitation progress in near real-time and adjust treatment plans as needed.

A Mindhub representative highlighted, "Zenicog’s algorithm optimizes each training session to align with individual goals based on users' abilities and past performance, fostering continuous improvement throughout the rehabilitation journey. We are thrilled to showcase this innovative solution at CES 2025 and explore abundant new business opportunities."

The representative further emphasized, "Mindhub is committed to leading innovation in digital healthcare for cognitive and language rehabilitation. We plan to enhance Zenicog’s capabilities and expand our business footprint. CES will serve as a vital platform to solidify our global strategy, focusing on senior care markets in the U.S., Japan, Singapore, and Vietnam."

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
